sam-pricing: Quick Q — running a pricing experiment next week where account-level promo credits auto-apply. Do we charge VAT on redeemed promo credits for EU customers? Example: credits reduce the invoice net amount.

maria-tax: Short answer: B2B with a valid VAT ID -> reverse charge, we don't charge VAT. B2C or missing/invalid VAT ID -> VAT applies on the net consideration. Promo credits are typically treated as a discount (i.e., reduce the taxable base) — so VAT is applied after credits. Need VIES validation for B2B.

ryan-sales: Two practical asks: 1) Can we capture VAT ID at trial/signup so we avoid manual rework? 2) For invoices already issued where VAT was charged but customer later provides VAT ID, can we reissue/remove VAT?

anna-cs: Customer example: OpenMap (NL) used credits, paid, then emailed a VAT ID. They want either refund or a corrected invoice.

acct-pay: Reissue path exists (credit note + new invoice). We need a tax reason code on the credit note. Will need confirmation from tax before we proceed.

maria-tax: Procedure: 1) Validate VAT ID with VIES snapshot. 2) If valid and customer is B2B, issue corrective credit note + new invoice with reverse-charge wording. Use annotation: "Reverse charge — customer liable" and include the validated VAT ID. For OSS/marketplace edge cases confirm place of supply — but for pure API SaaS we are supplier. Note: if the promo credit is a free marketing grant (no consideration given by customer), VAT consequence can differ; but in this experiment credits reduce price so treat as discount.

sam-pricing: UX question — should the pricing page show VAT-inclusive estimates or show price + "estimated VAT" for EU accounts?

ryan-sales: Show estimate. Also add a VAT ID field for business signups and validate before trial activation. If VIES fails, fallback to asking docs.

ledger-bot: Invoice generated: INV-2025-0098 for acct openmap. Link: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2025-0098

anna-cs: OpenMap supplied VAT ID: NL123456789B01 and says they prefer reissue rather than refund.

maria-tax: If VIES check passes (please attach screenshot), we can proceed with credit note + new invoice. Wording on new invoice: "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the customer (Article 196 EU)". Keep note: "discount applied via promo credits" in invoice narrative.

acct-pay: On it. I'll create a ticket with required fields: customer VAT ID, original invoice number, requested action (credit + reissue), VIES validation screenshot, tax approver (maria-tax).

sam-pricing: :thumbsup: I'll update the experiment doc and add a mandatory 'capture VAT ID' checkbox + link to the reissue SOP.

maria-tax: Also rec for engineering: log VAT ID capture timestamp and VIES response in billing metadata so audits are traceable.

ryan-sales: Thanks — I'll work with product to add the field and update the signup flow.

acct-pay: Ticket created: FIN-4721. Leaving for tax review.

sam-pricing: Great. FYI for the experiment spec — promo lines look like this in the invoice preview:

```
- usage: $1,200.00
- promo_credits: -$200.00
- net: $1,000.00
- VAT 21%: $210.00  <-- if B2C or missing VAT ID
```

sam-pricing: Any objections to going forward with capture + reissue flow as described?

maria-tax: No objections. Proceed, just ensure VIES screenshots are attached and we keep an audit trail.

anna-cs: I'll follow up with OpenMap once the reissue is ready.

ryan-sales: 👍

acct-pay: Closing here, will ping once credit note issued.
